text: Artificial intelligence is becoming part of our daily lives, so ethics in AI matters more than ever. One major problem is bias: if AI learns from unfair data, it can make unfair decisions about jobs, loans, or even medical care. Fairness means treating everyone equally, no matter who they are. Privacy is also important, because AI often collects and uses personal information. Companies must protect this data and use it honestly. Finally, transparency helps people understand how AI makes decisions. When developers build AI responsibly, they think about these issues from the start. In this way, we can enjoy the benefits of AI while respecting people's rights and building trust.
